name: windows-pet
title: Windows pet module: mascot + tray icon display
description: R14 pet module remaining Windows implementation: pet_set_topmost_level (SetWindowPos HWND_TOPMOST), pet_make_transparent (WS_EX_LAYERED + SetLayeredWindowAttributes), toggle_pet_mode/show_pet_if_hidden/set_pet_position Windows cfg-gate via Tauri stock API, pet_panel_macos NSPanel backend Windows equivalent (WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW + multi-screen Y-flip). Also investigate why tray icon doesn't show on Windows (tray_set_enabled looks cross-platform — check icon path/format, show_menu_on_left_click Windows behavior, showTrayIcon default hydration race).
